title: 50 In 23 HP Timecutter Ironforged Deck Kawasaki V-Twin Gas Dual Hydrostatic Zero Turn Riding Mower with Myride New
description:
You work too hard to let your lawn dictate your leisure schedule. Get serious comfort and a beautiful cut with Toro’s 42 in. TimeCutter. Combining a perfect blend of maneuverability and power, this mower makes quick work of the toughest tasks. And you’ll enjoy luxury comfort when the ride gets rocky with the MyRIDE suspension system that saves your body from the toughest terrain. This mower is easier to handle than ever with Toro’s Smart Speed Technology, which gives you total control over the mowing speed. And you can rest easy knowing that Toro stands behind its mowers with a 3-year/unlimited-hour residential warranty. And as a Toro owner, you’ll have access to more than 3,000 servicing dealers across the U.S. and Canada ready to assist you. Count on it.
Toro’s got your back, literally, our MyRIDE suspension system features a suspended rear and front shock adjustable operator platform that takes the bumps so your body doesn’t, instead of just relying on a foam seat and tires for cushion, MyRide is suspended above the iron forged deck for a ride so comfortable, you don’t need to go slow when it gets rough, and because we isolate the suspension from the frame, the deck stays level to the ground, giving you a higher quality cut, with MyRIDE, the best seat in the house is actually in the yard
More time for you, cut mowing time up to 50% with the zero-turn feature, and you’ll be amazed how quickly the powerful Kohler 22 HP engine moves the 42 in. deck around obstacles, giving you a gorgeous lawn and more time to enjoy it with family and friends
Space saver, mow in tight spaces and enjoy the extra-room in your shed or garage to store your kayaks, kids toys and everything in between with the TimeCutter’s 42 in. deck
Pick your pace, easier to handle than ever thanks to Toro’s Smart Speed Technology, which allows you to have total control over your mowing speed, while never sacrificing blade tip speed, ground speeds range of up to 7 mph in mow mode, 5.5 mph in tow mode and 4 mph in trim mode
Hassle-free maintenance, spend less time maintaining your mower with toolless air filter changes and belt covers
Pick the right fit for you, ideal for lawns up to 2 acres
Ride in style, ride your Toro in style with a handcrafted high-back seat with arm rests that provides the ultimate in padding and back support
Smooth moves, you’ll enjoy smooth steering that’s less jerky than the competition with shock-absorbing dampers, and you’ll glide over the grass with a fully tubular front axle with wide front casters
Out of the elements, keep mother nature off your back while you mow with protective tire fenders, unlike some competitors, these are standard on all timecutters, not only do the fenders shield your engine from tire spray, but also prevent backsplash on you
Easy cleaning, blast away grass buildup, caked-on mud and other debris under your mowing deck with washout ports you can directly attach to your garden hose
Pro DNA, the same, commercial-grade DNA that pros rely on-like thicker steel, lightning-fast blades, and belts reinforced with bullet-proof material-courses through every mower we build, giving homeowners with big acreage the same lawn-dominating power, durability, and precision to get the job done, the result, a beautiful, professional-looking lawn, developed and engineered in Minnesota, Toro’s innovations have been the heart and soul of mowing technology for more than a century
Built to last, your mower is no small investment, and that’s why timecutters come with a Toro ironforged deck engineered for-years of reliability and top performance, and we just don’t talk a good game, we back it up with belts reinforced with bullet-proof material, a 10-gauge steel deck shell, reinforced leading edge across the entire deck, and huge 6 in. spindles
